dedupe_keys.name: infoterre brgm geoscience data viewer france

description: InfoTerre (BRGM geoscience data viewer, France) is a hazard data portal run by BRGM (French Geological Survey). InfoTerre is a viewer of geoscience data: digital geological maps from 1:1,000,000 to 1:50,000, the Subsurface Data Bank (BSS) of boreholes and logs, ground-movement hazard mapping, clay shrinkage and swelling risk, underground cavities, groundwater flooding, seismic and industrial-site risk data. Coverage: France. Formats and interfaces named: WMS, WFS. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the page. Caveats: the page says data can be searched and downloaded and that OGC and INSPIRE standards are met, but it names no formats or licence, and it mixes geology with hazards so only part of it concerns infrastructure. It can support ground-condition and geohazard screening for networks and buried assets. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
